title: Understanding iloc
text: The iloc function is used to access a group of rows and columns by integer index. The first number is the row index, and the second is the column index.

title: Accessing Elements with iloc
text: When you use df.iloc[1,2], you're trying to access the element in the second row and third column. Check if the DataFrame has a third column.

title: Checking Column Index
text: Does the DataFrame have a column index 2?
